text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara happily recounts how she could 
hear so many voices cheering her on while 
she was running.

Haru Urara was able to run with all her 
heart and truly enjoy it... Yet, 
overwhelmed by the bitterness of defeat, 
she burst into tears.

Seeing Haru Urara express genuine 
frustration after running with all her 
might and losing, the Trainer truly felt 
her growth.

And so, having run with all her heart 
across the dream stage, Haru Urara's Arima 
Kinen came to an end.
